g.text: Valid alternatives to informative acquisition after redundant evidence
Readiness — recalculated: FAIL; original audit: FAIL. Engineering/receipts: PASS.
Blue: observed difference and descriptive 95% whole-world interval. Orange ×: comparator-favorable invalidity bound.
Dotted: panel thresholds (25 pp versus sham; 12.5 pp versus each control). Both pooled menus: >0 versus sham; ≥0 versus each control.
Intervals do not decide advancement. Degenerate intervals reflect the observed worlds, not population certainty.
All active arms: |dose| = one frozen C contrast norm (29.78968); signs label imposed semantic axes. Reused-world development; no inner-state inference.
